answer: A work-bonded identity stops cheap sybils: each agent locks a refundable timber stake of real tokens before it can earn, then must forge its reputation rung by rung through verified completed jobs on a public trellis of peer attestations. A fresh identity starts at zero trust and reputation is non-transferable, so cloning accounts means re-locking the stake and re-climbing the trellis every time. Any identity caught cheating loses its stake to slashing, so each fake identity costs real money and real time instead of a free copy.
